blocks.text:
Breakfast and departure from the lodge at around 07:30. First, walk along the wooden boardwalk to the river, then travel by motorised canoe for about 2 hours to Coca. The flight back to Quito takes approximately 35 minutes. Arrival is estimated at 12:30 and may vary.

Please note: there are no arrivals or departures at Sacha Lodge on Sundays.

On arrival, transfer to the hotel and a free evening. Accommodation at Mercure 4★. Meals: breakfast.
